text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hokko Tarumae's comeback race has concluded.
After a storm of thunderous applause...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Everyone... Thank you...
Truly... thank you so much...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The sporadic applause continued endlessly.
It was a warm round of applause, purely celebrating Hokko Tarumae's recovery.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "Hey, Tarumae. Running with you made me think, that time off didn't really affect you much at all, did it?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Even after such a long break, you still ran in true Tarumae fashion, you know?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Huh... Really? But my racing instincts still feel a bit off, you know. I feel kind of pathetic... or like I'm wasting my potential.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If only I'd bounced back sooner and trained with all my might,
I could've run so much better!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
What on earth was I doing...?
I really just want to give myself a good smack on the head.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: F-Fufufufu... Ahahaha☆

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: What is it, Rickey? What's wrong?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, I just remembered something.
Come to think of it, before—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"I remember getting scolded by Tarumae too.
She told me to stop getting distracted by feng shui and just run with all my might."

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ugh... I'm sorry, Rickey.
I guess I went a bit too far back then...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, you're always serious no matter who it is, Tarumae.
Even when it's about me, you treat it like it's your own.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: —Still!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: But...?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Pausing isn't a bad thing.
Stagnation can also be a vital foundation♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"Even if it looks like you've stopped, at first glance,
that's precious time to make sure you don't take a wrong next step, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's how we find our balance—and grow stronger♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"So don't rush it! And next time,
show me an even stronger Tarumae, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, Rickey...!
Next time, I'll show you! I'll be completely back to normal, and more than a match for you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, after returning to Tracen Academy,
we began discussing her next race, but—

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I can't wait☆
Hurry, let's get to the next race as soon as possible!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I feel the exact same way! As soon as possible,
I want to show my hometown fans that I'm completely back!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Approached in stereo from both left and right.
Which race would be most suitable for their rematch...?"
choice_data_list: How about the JBC Classic in early November?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"The JBC Classic...
It's in a month from now...
It's the longest race in the JBC series, right?"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: What do you say, Tarumae!?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Sure thing! Want to enter the JBC Sprint too?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I won't be entering, though!
Doing it all at once is impossible!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Just the JBC Classic then!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Yeah, right there~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
An Umamusume stealthily slipped
into the conversation out of nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Acute-san?! How long have you been there?!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I wonder when that was.
Way back when, or just a moment ago~?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Say, Rickey-chan, Tarumae-chan,
would you mind letting me join in next time?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Watching from home alone is pretty lonely after all~.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, sorry!
I didn't get a chance to cheer you on at the Nambu Hai!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Then next time, let's do it with the three of us!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Mhm-mhm, we've got to get along!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Thank you~. But
I don't know if we can get along, you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: I gotta "hustle" so I don't lose to those two either. Fuho~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wonder Acute breathes heavily through her nose.
With this, all the actors are in place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For their next race, the JBC Classic,
the three of them would stand side-by-side on the track once more.
